findings.description: Inocente Lopez died on 13 January 1906; his death was registered in the civil register of Suchitoto, Cuscatlán, El Salvador, which names his mother as Santos Lopez.
supporting_sources: El Salvador, Civil Registration, 1704-2001 — death entry for Inocente Lopez and Santos Lopez, 13 Jan 1906
